race.description: Book A Christmas Party @ Crjc Mdn Plate
race.comment: DREAM INVADER (1) was unplaced on debut at Newcastle, then sat on the speed with the 59kg for a fighting third over 1014m at Coffs Harbour. Key jockey change and expected to go on with it here. GENERAL DANCER (6) was in the firing line first up from the wide gate with a narrow third over 800m at Warwick. Can go on with it now from the low draw and shed her Maiden tag. HARVEY'S TURN (4) two runs back on the provincial tracks have only been fair and looks to find a winnable contest today. Faded late when eighth to Autumn Flyer over 1100m at Wyong. No excuses here. DENNY CEE (9) three-year-old Dracarys gelding from Final Dash on debut for the Owen Glue yard. Ran a sound second in a 1010m trial at Lismore. Well drawn and the lugging bit goes on. Respect.
